title: Backend bypasses feature-flags MCP gateway by writing features.json directly via fs
detail: CLAUDE.md mandates that backend/features.json is the source of truth for feature flags and may ONLY be mutated through the feature-flags MCP. backend/utils/featureFile.js opens FILE_PATH and performs read+atomicWrite directly from the Express process; featureController.updateFeature (PUT /api/feature-flags/:key) routes admin writes through this fs path. Two writer code paths (MCP + Express) target the same file with no cross-process locking - drift, race conditions and divergent invariants are inevitable. Cross-ref PERF-005, PERF-006.
fix: Make the MCP the single writer. Backend admin endpoints call the MCP over HTTP instead of fs.writeFile. Remove writeFeature from featureFile.js; keep only a read-only cached loader. Document as a new ADR.

title: Missing authorization layer - IDOR is an architectural gap
detail: getOrderById, updateOrderToPaid, getMyOrders only check authentication (protect) and never verify resource ownership. The project has no authorization layer between protect and the controller - every controller is expected to re-implement ownership checks by hand and most simply do not. Same gap as SEC-001 and SEC-002. Without an authz layer every new privileged route is one forgotten check away from IDOR.
fix: Introduce middleware/authz.js exporting ownsOrder, ownsResource(model, ownerField); wire after protect in routes. Cross-ref SEC-001, SEC-002.

title: Payment-state mutation in controller with no PaymentProvider abstraction
detail: updateOrderToPaid stores req.body.paymentResult verbatim (id, status, update_time, payer.email_address) without calling PayPal to verify the capture. No PaymentProvider interface, no Stripe-vs-PayPal seam. ADR-0003 documents runtime PayPal client-id but nothing about server-side verification. Both a security hole (SEC-002) and a leaky abstraction.
fix: Introduce PaymentProvider interface (verifyCapture(orderId, captureId)) with PayPalProvider. updateOrderToPaid calls provider.verifyCapture before mutating isPaid. Draft a new ADR.

title: No service layer - business logic in controllers, duplicated across routes
detail: updateUserProfile, updateUser, registerUser hand-roll the same shape (findById then mutate then save then JSON-shape with token). authUser duplicates JWT issuance and user-shape projection. CLAUDE.md convention (route then controller then Mongoose model) has no service layer, so business rules sit in HTTP handlers and cannot be reused by workers/CLI/agents. Undocumented decision worth an ADR.
fix: Either accept it via ADR (no service layer) and extract pure helpers (utils/userProjection.js, utils/orderTotals.js) to kill duplication, or introduce services/ for cross-cut flows (auth, payments, feature flags).

title: Auth-header construction duplicated in every thunk (no API client)
detail: Every authenticated thunk hand-builds a config object with an Authorization Bearer header from userInfo.token. ADR-0001 already flagged this consequence. With 20+ thunks the pattern is load-bearing; any new endpoint is one forgotten line away from a 401. The token-failed-to-logout handler is also copy-pasted (userActions.js:144, 187, 224, 258, 297).
fix: Create frontend/src/api/client.js - one axios instance with a request interceptor that reads token from store and a response interceptor that dispatches logout on 401. Migrate thunks file-by-file. No new ADR.

title: Derived-state computed and assigned to Redux objects inside render
detail: OrderScreen assigns order.itemsPrice during render onto a Redux-owned object retrieved via useSelector. PlaceOrderScreen.js does the same to cart (PERF-011). Layer violation: presentation writes into store; selectors lose meaning and shallow-equality re-render contracts break. Totals should be computed server-side or in a memoized selector.
fix: Move totals to the server (addOrderItems stores itemsPrice/taxPrice/shippingPrice/totalPrice); or extract selectOrderWithTotals(state) wrapped in reselect/useMemo. Cross-ref PERF-011.

title: Cross-cutting config endpoint inlined in server.js instead of routes/configRoutes.js
detail: app.get(/api/config/paypal) is hand-mounted in server.js between feature-flag routes and the SPA fallback. ADR-0003 documents the runtime-config pattern as generalizable (Stripe, GA, Sentry DSN), but there is no routes/configRoutes.js, no controller, no JSDoc, and no Cache-Control. Adding a second public config means another inline app.get, hitting the register-API-BEFORE-wildcard gotcha from CLAUDE.md. Cross-ref SEC-014, PERF-016.
fix: Extract backend/routes/configRoutes.js with a small configController; mount app.use(/api/config, configRoutes) BEFORE the SPA fallback.

title: Upload route mixes infrastructure with handler and bypasses auth layer
detail: uploadRoutes.js inlines multer disk-storage config, the file-filter, the route handler and the response shaping in 42 lines with no controller separation, no auth middleware, no storage abstraction. Files land on ephemeral local FS (CLAUDE.md: Heroku dyno reset wipes uploads). URL shape derived from req.file.path leaks filesystem layout into the API contract - future S3/Cloudinary swap is a breaking change. Cross-ref SEC-008, PERF-015.
fix: Introduce a Storage abstraction (utils/storage.js: put(buffer, mime) returns publicUrl) with LocalDiskStorage today, S3Storage tomorrow. Move multer config into uploadController; require protect+admin. Draft ADR for storage decision.

title: connectDB called at import time with no readiness gate or shutdown hook
detail: connectDB() fires at module load before app.listen, but server.js does not await it, does not expose /healthz or /readyz, registers no SIGTERM/SIGINT handler. Heroku sends SIGTERM on dyno restart; in single-process prod (ADR-0002) in-flight requests are killed mid-write. Absence of a lifecycle layer.
fix: Await connectDB() before app.listen; add /healthz and /readyz; register process.on(SIGTERM) to mongoose.disconnect() and server.close(). Extends ADR-0002.

title: admin middleware returns 401 instead of 403 - authn vs authz conflated
detail: protect returns 401 for missing/invalid token (correct). admin returns 401 for an authenticated non-admin - that is a 403 case. No clean separation between authn and authz error channels. Combined with ARCH-002, explains the brittle logout-on-error-text match in userActions.js:144.
fix: admin middleware should respond 403 with code NOT_ADMIN. Frontend interceptor (ARCH-005) branches on status code, not error message text.

title: Persistence layer hand-rolled in store.js - no boundary between localStorage and Redux
detail: store.js rehydrates cartItems / userInfo / shippingAddress from localStorage at module load, and every relevant thunk hand-writes to localStorage in parallel with dispatching. No single persistence boundary. Failure modes: cart serialized shape and reducer initialState shape can drift, data:destroy wipes Mongo but not localStorage (CLAUDE.md gotcha), JWT persisted in three places (ADR-0001 smell).
fix: Either adopt redux-persist with whitelist (cart, userLogin), or write persistenceMiddleware.js that subscribes to the store and writes whitelisted slices. Remove ad-hoc localStorage.setItem from thunks.

title: Two ADR folders coexist - real ADRs vs synthetic RAG corpus - confusion risk
detail: docs/adr/ holds 3 real fork ADRs. docs/project-data/adrs/ holds adr-001..005 which are synthetic RAG corpus describing original proshop decisions - not active. No README marks docs/project-data/* as a do-not-treat-as-decisions zone. An agent reading a synthetic ADR and acting on it as if it were a real decision is a realistic failure mode.
fix: Add docs/README.md explaining the split. Optionally rename docs/project-data/adrs/ to docs/project-data/synthetic-adrs/ and update build_chunks.py path constants.

title: MCP and backend hard-couple to the same JSON file via relative path - no schema
detail: FILE resolves to ../../backend/features.json relative to MCP source. MCP reaches across module boundaries into backend/ by relative path. No JSON schema for the file shape, no shared types between TS server and JS backend, no migration story. If features.json moves both processes silently break, in two languages, with no compile-time signal. Duplicate raw readFile in list_features (line 67) bypasses load() - drift smell.
fix: Define a JSON schema (zod in MCP, ajv in backend) shared via a tiny package or schema-as-code with checksum comment. Better: declare MCP as the only writer (ARCH-001) and have backend ask it over HTTP.

title: mcp-project-docs imports scripts/rag_query.py via sys.path mutation
detail: server.py does sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT)) then imports HybridRetriever, RAGAnswerer from scripts.rag_query. scripts/ has __init__.py but is not an installable package; the retriever is instantiated at module import (line ~96). Two coupling problems: sys.path mutation makes repo-local modules shadow installed packages (SEC-017), and the MCP cannot evolve independently of scripts/. The two-Python-RAG-stacks picture (scripts/ ingestion + scripts/rag_query retrieval + mcp-project-docs server) has no documented split.
fix: Promote rag/ to an installable package (pip install -e .) with a clear API (rag.Retriever, rag.Answerer). Remove sys.path mutation. Lazy-init retriever inside the tool function. Draft ADR for RAG boundaries.

title: No route-level authorization in the SPA; admin routes protected only at backend
detail: App.js declares every route flat in a single Router with no PrivateRoute / AdminRoute wrapper. CLAUDE.md says screens guard via userInfo.isAdmin - but that guard is inlined per-screen (each admin screen has its own useEffect redirect). Easy to forget on a new admin screen; FeatureListScreen.js was added without a wrapper. Backend enforcement (ARCH-002) is the real defense; SPA leaks admin URL surface.
fix: Add PrivateRoute and AdminRoute higher-order route components (react-router v5 render prop that checks userInfo / userInfo.isAdmin and redirects to /login). Wrap admin routes. Drop per-screen isAdmin redirects.

title: Anaemic Mongoose models - review-add and rating recalculation live in controller
detail: createProductReview mutates the embedded reviews array, recalculates product.numReviews and product.rating, and saves the product, inside the HTTP handler. orderModel/productModel/userModel are pure schemas with only matchPassword on User. Anaemic-domain-model anti-pattern: domain rules (one-review-per-user, rating-is-mean-of-reviews) live next to res.json calls and cannot be exercised from elsewhere (seeder, tests, n8n agent). Cross-ref ARCH-004.
fix: Either expose Product.addReview(userId, rating, comment) as a Mongoose method, or extract services/reviewService.js (consistent with ARCH-004 service-layer ADR).

title: Error contract is implicit - frontend matches error text to trigger logout
detail: errorMiddleware returns message and optional stack. Backend throws Error(Not authorized, token failed) in authMiddleware:24 and the frontend matches that exact string in 4+ thunks (userActions:144, 187, 224, 258, 297) to decide whether to dispatch logout. No machine-readable error code field, no error-shape contract. Any backend wording change silently breaks logout-on-expired-token across the SPA. Absence of an API error envelope.
fix: Define an API error envelope (code, message, details) in errorMiddleware. Map known errors to stable codes (TOKEN_INVALID, NOT_ADMIN, FEATURE_NOT_FOUND, DEPENDENCY_NOT_ENABLED). Frontend interceptor branches on code, not text.
